Assault Vest.rules: After damage is calculated for a physical hit, gain one HP tick of temporary HP. Pokémon equipment.

Rocky Helmet.rules: When targeted by a melee attack, its attacker loses one HP tick. Pokémon equipment.

Scope Lens.rules: Expand your critical hit range by 1. Pokémon equipment.

Quick Boots.rules: Gain +2 Movement. You may act at the start of each round. If multiple combatants can do so, resolve priority with Luck plus Speed. Pokémon equipment.

Analytic Lens.rules: Gain +1 to Effect Ranges. Pokémon equipment.

Leftovers.rules: Spend a Swift and Movement action to choose one HP tick of healing or temporary HP. Pokémon equipment.

Psionic Vest.rules: After damage is calculated for a special hit, gain one HP tick of temporary HP. Pokémon equipment.
